title: Input schema for TikTok comments scraper
description: Scrapes comments from individual videos fast and with ease.

postURLs.title: TikTok video URLs
postURLs.description: Add the video URLs you want to extract comments from. Enter URLs one by one or edit it in bulk.

commentsPerPost.title: Maximum comments (replies included) per post
commentsPerPost.description: The number of comments extracted from every result. Due to TikTok API limitations, the actual number of scraped comments may differ, especially for posts with thousands of comments.

topLevelCommentsPerPost.title: Maximum top-level comments per post
topLevelCommentsPerPost.description: The maximum number of top-level (non-reply) comments you want from a single post.

maxRepliesPerComment.title: Maximum replies per comment
maxRepliesPerComment.description:
The maximum number of replies you want from a single comment. 

Note: Successful extraction of all desired replies is currently not guaranteed.

profiles.title: Usernames
profiles.description: Add one or multiple TikTok usernames you want to scrape. You can enter the usernames one by one, or use the Bulk edit section to add a prepared list.
profiles.sectionDescription: Alternatively, add one or multiple TikTok usernames whose videos' comments you want to scrape. Imporant: Don't forget to fill out the 💯 Number of videos you want to scrape in the section below.

resultsPerPage.title: 💯 Number of videos per profile
resultsPerPage.description: Add the number of videos you want to scrape per profile.

profileScrapeSections.title: Profile sections to scrape
profileScrapeSections.description: If a profile has reposted videos, you can scrape them by selecting Reposts

profileSorting.title: Profile video sorting
profileSorting.description: Select Latest to scrape the most recent videos first, Oldest - the oldest videos first, Popular - the most popular videos first. Date filters only work with Latest and Oldest. Note: Popular sorting is limited by TikTok to approximately 400–500 videos per profile and may return significantly fewer results than Latest or Oldest.

oldestPostDateUnified.title: Scrape profile videos published after [date]
oldestPostDateUnified.description: Optional filter. Only videos uploaded after or on this date will be scraped. Alternatively, specify how old the scraped videos should be in days. Putting 1 will get you only today's posts, 2 - yesterday's and today's, and so on.

newestPostDate.title: Scrape videos published before [date]
newestPostDate.description: Optional filter. Only videos uploaded before or on this date will be scraped.

excludePinnedPosts.title: Exclude pinned posts
excludePinnedPosts.description: Tick to exclude pinned posts from profiles. Pinned posts are usually the first videos on a profile's page.
